name: es20-clear-viewport-scissor
title: Clear, viewport and scissor
summary: Clear values and masks, the scissor test, the viewport transform and glDepthRangef in a 4x4 gallery; depth and stencil contents are observed through depth- and stencil-tested probe draws, validated against a CPU-painted reference.
spec: ES 3.0 §2.13.1 Controlling the Viewport (viewport transform, DepthRangef, MAX_VIEWPORT_DIMS)
ES 3.0 §4.1.4 Stencil Test and §4.1.5 Depth Buffer Test (used as observers)
ES 3.0 §4.2.2 Fine Control of Buffer Updates
ES 3.0 §6.1 state tables 6.5, 6.11, 6.12 and 6.28 (queried values and initial state)
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.3.5 Uniform Variables, §4.5.4 Default Precision Qualifiers, §7.1 Vertex Shader Special Variables (gl_VertexID, gl_Position)

api.glClear: COLOR, DEPTH and STENCIL singly and combined; honours scissor box and write masks; an empty mask clears nothing and raises no error
api.glClearColor: cleared pixels equal round(c*255) +-1; out-of-range components are clamped; GL_COLOR_CLEAR_VALUE round trip and initial (0,0,0,0)
api.glClearDepthf: observed through GL_LESS probe quads (depth ruler, scissored and masked clears, combined clear); GL_DEPTH_CLEAR_VALUE round trip, clamping to [0,1], initial 1.0
api.glClearStencil: observed through per-bit stencil EQUAL probes (bit ruler, masked clears, combined clear); value masked to the stencil planes; GL_STENCIL_CLEAR_VALUE round trip, initial 0
api.glViewport: NDC squares land on the exact pixel rectangles of the viewport transform (small, offset, negative-origin and four-quadrant viewports); clear ignores it; oversized width clamped to MAX_VIEWPORT_DIMS; negative size -> INVALID_VALUE with state unchanged; GL_VIEWPORT initial value and round trip
api.glScissor: clears and draws are cut to exactly left<=x<left+width, bottom<=y<bottom+height (corner and neighbour pixels checked); 0x0 and zero-width boxes reject everything; negative size -> INVALID_VALUE with state unchanged; GL_SCISSOR_BOX initial value and round trip
api.glEnable: GL_SCISSOR_TEST on cuts the draw to the box; GL_DEPTH_TEST and GL_STENCIL_TEST gate the probe quads (without them every probe would be lit)
api.glDisable: GL_SCISSOR_TEST off makes the scissor box irrelevant (panel O); GL_DEPTH_TEST off before the stencil probes of panel K (otherwise they would fail the depth test)
api.glIsEnabled: SCISSOR_TEST initially FALSE, TRUE after glEnable, FALSE after glDisable
api.glColorMask: each of R, G, B, A enabled alone on a clear, and R+B+A / G on a draw: only those channels change; GL_COLOR_WRITEMASK round trip and initial value; an all-false mask leaves the buffer untouched
api.glDepthMask: a depth clear with the mask off leaves the old depth (probe still passes where the depth is 1.0); GL_DEPTH_WRITEMASK round trip and initial TRUE
api.glStencilMask: partial-nibble clears give (old & ~mask) | (clear & mask) in the stencil bit ruler; mask 0 clears nothing; GL_STENCIL_WRITEMASK and back mask round trip, initial all ones
api.glStencilMaskSeparate: front mask 0xFF / back mask 0x00 still clears all bits (a clear uses the front mask); BACK only changes GL_STENCIL_BACK_WRITEMASK
api.glDepthRangef: four ranges incl. reversed (1,0): the probe passes or fails exactly as z_w = (f-n)/2 z_d + (n+f)/2 predicts; GL_DEPTH_RANGE round trip, clamping to [0,1]
api.glStencilFunc: EQUAL with ref == mask == (1<<bit) isolates one stencil bit; EQUAL 0x42 / 0x41 accept and reject the cleared value
api.glGetIntegerv: GL_VIEWPORT, GL_SCISSOR_BOX, GL_STENCIL_CLEAR_VALUE, GL_STENCIL_WRITEMASK, GL_STENCIL_BACK_WRITEMASK, GL_MAX_VIEWPORT_DIMS
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of the whole default framebuffer; every gallery check is a comparison with it
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLE_STRIP with 4 vertices (probe quads) and TRIANGLES with 3 (oversized and viewport triangles); pixels checked
api.glUseProgram: probe program current for all draws
api.glUniform2fv: u_vertex[4] corner array steers the probe geometry (visible in every panel)
api.glUniform1f: u_z (NDC depth) decides the depth-probe results

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi capture (es-max) viewed: 4x4 gallery of flat panels, no bleed between neighbours. Top row: blue clear; navy panel with a gold box; four strips (pink R, mint G, blue B, dark-blue A-only) over the base color; orange left half / teal right half. Row 2: depth ruler staircase growing 2/6/10/14 columns from bottom to top; green panel with a dark square (masked second clear left no mark); cyan blocks showing the four depth ranges (one diagonal pair, one full column, one empty column); slate panel with an orange viewport rectangle. Row 3: stencil bit-ruler patterns; purple panel with a yellow block in its upper right (the depth and stencil probes that passed); steel panel with an amber box. Bottom row: teal viewport rectangle with a pink inner rectangle; four triangles in four quadrants; mint and coral squares from the negative-origin viewport; violet rectangle from the clipped triangle. llvmpipe captures differ from it by at most 1 per channel.
